direct_mappings.event_description: A new process has been created: REG.exe ADD HKCU\Environment /v UserInitMprLogonScript /t REG_SZ /d C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat /f
direct_mappings.technique_name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: The event shows the modification of the `UserInitMprLogonScript` registry key using `reg.exe`, which directly aligns with the technique's description of achieving persistence through registry modification for autostart execution.
recommendations: Monitor registry keys related to autostart execution for unauthorized modifications.
Implement restrictions on the use of `reg.exe` to prevent unauthorized registry changes.
Scan the system for the presence of the `art.bat` file and remove it.

direct_mappings.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: The creation of a batch file (`art.bat`) in the Temp directory, especially when combined with the registry modification, indicates the use of the Windows Command Shell to execute malicious commands. While not a perfect match, the batch file will be executed by cmd.exe.
recommendations: Monitor for the creation of executable files in temporary directories.
Analyze the contents of the `art.bat` file to determine its purpose.
Implement application control policies to restrict the execution of unauthorized scripts.
